mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so the current level of 4.0% predicts negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, as indicated by a sustained rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% increase over 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so the current level of 5.0% predicts negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 350000.0, it signals weak consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates policy easing.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 350000.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of weak retail sales (RSAFS < 350000.0) and low housing starts (HOUST < 2000.0) signals a recessionary risk, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so the current level of 108.96 predicts negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
